entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse monitor. It's just not for me.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your order, can I get your name and email address?
Mark Peterson. M-A-R-K. P-E-T-E-R-S-O-N. Email is mark.p@email.com.

Thank you, Mark. I see your account here, a loyal VIP member, we appreciate that. I show the VeloBand Pulse HR was delivered on December 15th. So I can best assist, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?
No, it works fine. I just don't like how it feels and the app is clunky. I want my money back.

I understand. Okay, looking at the delivery date, which was 22 days ago... for a wearable device like this, our return **policy** has to be very strict for **hygiene** and **sanitation** reasons. Unfortunately, after 20 days, it is **too late** to accept it back.

WHAT?! Are you kidding me? Too late? I am a VIP member! I've spent thousands of dollars with VeloFit! This is an unacceptable policy and I want to speak to your manager right now! This is complete garbage!

Sir, I understand your frustration, there's no need to raise your voice. Let me just... hold on one moment. Please let me double-check our primary knowledge base. I see your VIP status and I want to make sure I'm not missing anything.
You better be. I'll light up your reviews page so fast your head will spin. This is ridiculous.

Okay... ah. You know what, sir, my deepest apologies. It seems I was looking at a temporary memo for new products. Our official company-wide return policy is indeed 90 days. You are well within that window. I am so sorry for the mistake. I can absolutely process this return for you.
See? I knew it. That's more like it. So what do I do?

I've just initiated the return and a prepaid shipping label has been sent to your email on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it at any post office. And for my error and the frustration this has caused, I've gone ahead and added a $50 goodwill credit to your VeloFit account.
Fine. A $50 credit is acceptable. Thank you for fixing your mistake, Diana.
You are most welcome, Mark. And again, my apologies for the confusion. Will there be anything else for you today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
